headlines.title: Nvidia stock bounces as Trump administration pushes for rehiring of Jensen Huang
headlines.summary: This is the tape-mover of the morning — Nvidia is the single most important stock in the market right now, down 30% in six weeks and dragging the whole AI complex with it. White House pressure to reinstate Jensen Huang is a genuine catalyst that could reverse sentiment across semis, hyperscalers, and every name that's been caught in the AI rout. Watch NVDA, AMD, SMCI, and the SOX index for the read-through.

headlines.title: Cybersecurity stocks have been hot — and now CrowdStrike inks deal to buy Zscaler
headlines.summary: A $43.9 billion all-stock megadeal in cybersecurity is the kind of M&A that reprices the entire sector — every name from Palo Alto to Fortinet to SentinelOne gets a fresh look when the biggest player on the tape makes a move this size. CRWD shareholders will scrutinize the dilution while ZS holders cash in; expect the whole cyber cohort to gap at the open. This also feeds the broader M&A-record narrative that's running counter to the AI selloff story.

headlines.title: The U.S. may enter a recession if the Fed raises rates, hedge-fund manager Bill Ackman says
headlines.summary: Ackman calling out recession risk from a Fed hike is the kind of loud, public warning that moves the long bond and puts a bid under rate-sensitive names — especially with the market already in correction mode and gold bouncing off its worst week in months. The Fed-pause debate is the macro overhang on everything right now; when a name like Ackman goes on record, the bond market listens. Macro hit rates in my track record are weak, so I'm keeping the score honest.
